snippet.title: Abyss Chamber - Announcement Trailer | Psychological 3D Horror Game  made in Godot
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4377360/Abyss_Chamber

Abyss Chamber is a psychological horror that allows you to experience life in an underground research facility. You will be surrounded by scary entities, but your job is to take care of one, which could be very dangerous if you don't obey the rules and fulfill all of her wishes.

It's a story driven psychological horror game that I was working on in the past year on the Godot engine.
